profile.headline: Senior Frontend Developer at UA Brands | UI/UX Developer
profile.summary: Innovative UX/UI developer with over 15 years of experience designing, developing, and managing web applications. I am passionate about technologies and the challenge to develop for different environments. Detailed with aesthetics and clean code, I am restless at problem solving and always eager to learn.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Lead Frontend Developer at UA Brands. Responsible for developing and maintaining responsive, user-friendly features for high-traffic e-commerce websites built on the Salesforce Commerce Cloud platform using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript frameworks (React.js).
-  Collaborated closely with UI/UX designers and back-end developers to create seamless, visually appealing customer experiences.
-  Work closely with business stakeholders implementing new features and functionality on the Salesforce Commerce Cloud platform.
- Optimized website performance for speed, scalability, SEO, and cross-browser compatibility.
- Translated design wireframes into high-quality, production-ready code while maintaining brand consistency.
- Integrated front-end components with back-end systems and third-party APIs to enhance site functionality.
- Conducted thorough debugging and troubleshooting of front-end issues to ensure a smooth user experience.
- Implemented A/B testing strategies to improve customer engagement and conversion rates.
- Applied best practices in responsive design, web accessibility, and web standards compliance.
- Used version control systems (Git) to manage codebase and collaborate effectively with team members.
- Stayed current with emerging front-end technologies and e-commerce trends to continually enhance the online shopping experience.

positions.title: UI/UX Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for the digital section of the media department of Royal Media Partners, exclusive onboard media partner of Royal Caribbean Cruises LTD.
Designed, developed and maintained three websites and two mobile apps for the Port Shopping program: RoyalPortfolio.com, PortShoppingSpree.com and RegisterYourPurchases.com. Mobile apps: Port Shopping Caribbean and Port Shopping Alaska.
Designed and developed iPad and tablet mobile apps for digital magazines and port guides using HTML, CSS and jQuery Mobile: Horizons, Axess, Portfolio and Spree.
Design and developed a touch-screen port guide for digital kiosks on the new Celebrity Cruises fleet, offline web application with jQuery, HTML, CSS and data feed in JSON.
Also developed and maintained a web based internal tool to log customer service  communications. Designed and developed a iOS private mobile app to track revenues in port for both accounting and fleet departments.

positions.title: UI/UX Developer
positions.description: Design and implementation of user interface for two web-based applications for Starwood users and partners to manage assets and estimate earnings and liquidity. Work closely with the development team to ensure seamless UI integration using HTML/CSS and JavaScript for a positive and coherent user experience. Integrate Bootstrap for mobile-first design and define visual styles for KendoUI elements.

positions.title: UI/UX Developer
positions.description:
Lead designer for PrestaShop.com website and forum, ecommerce platform serving 300,000 online stores around the world and monthly traffic over 1 million visitors.
Designed and developed a new UI/UX for PrestaShop.com integrating HTML/CSS with modular templates in the content management system.
Collaborate with developers in developing user interfaces to new plugins and add-ons for the software.
